scenario: LSIG.3 / LSER.13.5 / LGRA.7.1 CC-1: an `integral … gap zero` observation-triple parses, validates and lowers cleanly — the gap-policy grammar phrase is accepted on `integral`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Flow scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    q: Float mutable

series Flow.q:
    integral sliding 5_min gap zero

rule r:
    Flow f where f.integral > 1000000000.0
->
    log info "x"
